name: ToneMapping
declaration: public enum ToneMapping : uint
summary: The display transform that compresses scene radiance into the screen's range.

values.name: Filmic
values.summary: Filmic ACES-style curve with a soft toe and highlight desaturation, similar to Unreal's default; the most cinematic.

values.name: Neutral
values.summary: Khronos PBR Neutral: keeps material colours accurate up to bright highlights.

values.name: AcesFit
values.summary: Narkowicz's per-channel ACES fit (the legacy curve; saturated highlights).
